svg.aria-label: SceneColor before/after: one common display transform
svg.title: SceneColor before/after: one common display transform
svg.desc: Captured buffer visualization. SceneColor before/after: one common display transform graph 0001 | same exposure 0.384588805, Reinhard and sRGB OETF for both halves BEFORE: RenderLight AFTER: DiffuseIndirectComposite shared transform only; no per-image percentile This comparison is the acceptance-check image: both halves were rendered from raw half-float SceneColor with the identical exposure 0.384588805461, Reinhard c/(1+c) and sRGB OETF. The before version is the Ceiling-area-light RenderLight output; after is DiffuseIndirectComposite. The difference is the indirect-diffuse/specular composite, not an exposure change. Each half is a 2x downsample of the exact 1280x720 view rect; the source crop remains 1280x720 for both.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
